newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Climax sells part of HK Wanchai property.
newsitem.headline: Climax sells part of HK Wanchai property.

text.p: Climax International Co Ltd said on Thursday one of its units has provisionally agreed to a partial sale of its property at Capital Building in downtown Wanchai, Hong Kong, for HK$72.75 million.
The buyer, Rise Path Investments Ltd, is an independent third party, it said in a statement.
Proceeds of the sale would be used as working capital and would provide the Climax group with savings in interest payments, thus reducing its gearing ratio from 1.4 to 1.2.
Climax would also record a small exceptional gain from the sale of this asset, it said.
